title: Start and transition smoothness
summary: Feedback centers on how smooth the vehicle feels during starts, stopping transitions, and similar operating changes, with many fragments too brief or comparative to determine clear satisfaction.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe transition behavior as annoying or note minor issues during the transition that should feel smoother.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention smoother starts or transitions, but the short or comparative wording does not make the customer’s overall evaluation clear.

limitations: Most examples are very short fragments, which limits confidence about the full customer intent.
The undetermined set includes comparative and incomplete statements, so it cannot be cleanly interpreted as positive or negative.
This is a small stratified sample and is not representative of all G60 feedback on this topic.
